summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AI Lead Qualification CRM. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passing (auth, CRUD, AI qualify, stats, requalify, CSV import, filters, scoping). Frontend: verified demo login, dashboard stat cards + chart + recent leads, add-lead with AI qualification (~10s), search filter, lead detail (all AI fields, stage-select, requalify, copy-followup, save), delete flow, CSV import buttons present. All critical flows work end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Calls navigate('/') during render (line 16) causing React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Should be inside useEffect.

issues: A11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby attribute

action_items: OPTIONAL: Move `if (ready && user) navigate('/')` in AuthPage.js inside a useEffect to eliminate React setState-in-render warning.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to add-lead and delete dialogs for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handles ObjectId correctly via lead_to_public/user pop.
CSV import is sequential (N*~10s per row) - acceptable for MVP but could be parallelized with asyncio.gather.
JWT secret loaded from env - good. bcrypt used with $2b$ - good.
Auth stored as localStorage 'crm_token' (Bearer) - matches request context; server also accepts cookie fallback.
seed_data_creation: One 'Sarah Chen / Acme Corp' lead pre-existed for demo user (seeded by main agent). All UITEST_/TEST_ prefixed data cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env). Reuse it for regression. All AI calls take ~5-15s so use timeouts >= 45s. Auth = Bearer JWT in localStorage 'crm_token'. CSV import is O(N * AI latency).
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Only two minor non-blocking observations documented above.
